messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — streaming path (us-west2) p99 tail spike detected. p95 from ~220ms -> 1.2s, p99 -> 4.6s, streaming stall rate +3.2%. Paging on-call. @oncall-eng :rotating_light:
Anna C: on it. seeing the alert now. any quick notes on customer impact? :eyes:
Jamal R: Graphs show bulk of p99 coming from the continuous-batcher / stream-packer service. CPU on packer nodes ~85%, kv-cache evictions up 4x. Query I ran: grafana /streaming/p99?var=us-west2 -> trending with seq_len > 1024.
Lucy P: sounds like mixed sequence length amplification. short requests get delayed when a few super-long sequences are in the same batch. continuous batching + packer fairness likely the root. also saw packer queue depth spikes and a couple of stalled gRPC streams.
Mike H: initial mitigation in progress: lowering max_batch for stream-packer pools in us-west2 to 8 and enabling preemptive-shed for long requests. Running command: ```
# reduce pack size
redwoodctl config set --service stream-packer --region us-west2 --max-batch 8
redwoodctl rollout restart --service stream-packer --region us-west2
```
Sara V: copy — I'm starting customer impact triage. We got 3 support pings in last 8m, one enterprise tenant "novasync" reporting 8–12s responses on chat completions. escalating to CSM.
deploy-bot: rolling restart accepted. 6/12 packer pods restarting in us-west2, expected warm-up ~90s per pod. Logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:22:05Z packer-usw2-3 Restarting
2026-03-15T14:23:40Z packer-usw2-3 Ready
```
Jamal R: adding a short-term routing tweak: shifting 20% of streaming traffic for high-seq tenants to dedicated-stream-1. Command: `redwoodctl route set --policy weight --from streaming.us-west2 --to dedicated-stream-1 --weight 20`
Anna C: good. also enabling streaming debug traces for a 15m window to capture KV eviction and packer scheduling hops. will post trace ids here.
Lucy P: additional quick mitigation: reduce per-request max_kv_size and aggressively evict old KV for sequences > 2048. Patch I pushed to canary: ```
# canary config snippet
streaming.packer:
  seqlen_threshold: 2048
  kv_eviction_policy: aggressive
  seqlen_preempt: true
```
Mike H: monitoring p95/p99 now. Initial effect post-rollout: p95 -> 380ms, p99 -> 1.8s (improved but still above SLO). Seeing fewer streaming stalls but a small increase in token drop for super-long sequences (tracked).
Sara V: customer comms: drafted short note for NovaSync -> "We're investigating increased latency for long-running streaming responses in us-west2; temporary routing and configuration changes applied. We'll follow up with timeline and RCA." Sending now.
Jamal R: plotted per-tenant tail contribution. top three contributors: nova-sync (38% of p99), dev-playground (22%), metrics-corp (11%). Might need per-tenant queue isolation in next wave.
Anna C: handoff plan: Mike/SRE will own live mitigation for next 30m, Lucy/infra to own config follow-up and canary for seqlen-aware batching, Sara to own customer comms/CS handoff. We'll regroup at +30 and decide rollback. anyone object?
Lucy P: +1. long-term ops TODO: implement seqlen-aware packer bins, preemptive time-slicing, and a multi-queue scheduler to avoid noisy neighbor sequences. filing infra ticket after this.
Mike H: leaving monitor on. will escalate to SRE lead if p99 > 3s for another 10m. posting monitor checks and alert hooks now.
ops-bot: Pager escalated to SRE lead @sre-lead. Incident severity set to sev2. Logging timeline and actions under incident-3400001111.
Sara V: thanks all — handing off active pager to Mike. I'll continue customer comms and update the incident channel. please drop any follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
